EN: So much blood. I can't stop it. I'm afraid the Sheriff doesn't have much longer.
ZH: 血流了一地。我止不住。恐怕警长撑不了多久了。

EN: I guess I'm not as charming as I thought. The Ghoul refuses to talk to me.
ZH: 我根本没自己想的那么有魅力。尸鬼拒绝和我说话。

EN: I pushed my luck. The Merchant didn't like the deal I proposed.
ZH: 是我得寸进尺了。商人并不喜欢我提的买卖。

EN: The Talon Company Mercs drew their guns and told me to leave. I did.
ZH: 鹰爪公司的雇佣兵拔出他们的枪，让我离开。我照做了。

EN: I couldn't locate the Yao Guai. The Hunter thinks I'm completely incompetent.
ZH: 我找不到妖怪熊。猎人认为我很无能。

EN: The Drunken Drifter thought I took too big a gulp. He left angry, and took his bottle.
ZH: 醉酒的流浪者嫌我一口灌得太猛，气冲冲地走了，酒瓶也拿走了。

EN: The Brotherhood Patrol doesn't trust me. They ordered me to leave, or they'd open fire.
ZH: 兄弟会巡逻队不信任我。他们命令我离开，否则他们会开枪。

EN: I couldn't find the settlement. Now the Lost Farmer is even worse off than before.
ZH: 我找不到定居点。现在迷路的农民的状况比以前更糟了。

EN: Nope. I was wrong. Repairing the Mister Handy is way too technical for me.
ZH: 不，我错了。修理巧手先生对我来说太难了。

EN: I can't do it. I'm just not strong enough.
ZH: 我做不到，我的力气还不够大。

EN: Shouldn't have done that! I had to run out with the building collapsing behind me.
ZH: 就不该那么干！大楼在我身后轰然坍塌，我只好夺路而逃。

EN: I can't get close enough. The Lake's radiation is making me sick.
ZH: 我无法靠近。湖水的辐射使我感到恶心。

EN: The Room's security is too advanced. I can't get the door open.
ZH: 这个房间的安保太高级了，我根本打不开那扇门。

EN: A blade trap I failed to spot nearly took my head off. I better turn back.
ZH: 一个我没察觉到的刀片陷阱，差点把我的脑袋削下来。还是回头吧。

EN: It's no good, they won't open the door. I guess I better move on.
ZH: 不太妙，他们不开门。我想我还是继续往前吧。

EN: Walked right into a string of tin cans. Time to run!
ZH: 一脚踩进一串锡罐，绊线警报响了。赶紧跑！

EN: There's absolutely nothing left. I'm not surprised, but it's still disappointing.
ZH: 什么都没剩下。我不觉得惊讶，就是有点失望。

EN: It's a lost cause. I can't make heads or tails of all these wires and capacitors.
ZH: 没救了。这一堆电线和电容，我根本理不出个头绪。

EN: That just made them angrier. I got scratched up running past them to the exit.
ZH: 这让他们更愤怒了。跑向出口的途中我被抓伤了。

EN: It's still going, but I'm exhausted. There's no way I'll catch it now.
ZH: 它还在跑，可我已经筋疲力尽。这下说什么也追不上它了。

EN: I made it to the nearest tree line without incident.
ZH: 我一路无事，跑到了最近的树林边缘。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Fancy Lads snack cakes provide excellent sustenance.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：俏男孩夹心蛋糕提供了极好的营养。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Whoever chose the name “Deathclaw” wasn't kidding.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：起了“死爪”这个名字的人可真不是在开玩笑。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Societal infrastructure is completely dismantled.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：社会的基础设施早已彻底瓦解。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. In the Wasteland, trust can get you killed.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：在废土上，轻信会害你送命。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Some pre-war robots remain, but programming often faulty.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：一些战前机器人仍然存在，但程序经常出现故障。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Old religions mostly gone, replaced by cults.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：旧日的宗教大多消亡，取而代之的是邪教。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Everyone is armed. Guns are commonplace.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：人人身上都带着家伙。枪支随处可见。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Fashion is dead. You wear what keeps you alive.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：时尚已死。你只穿那些能让你活命的装备。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. TVs don't work, but radio broadcasts are common.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：电视早就没法用了，倒是无线电广播很常见。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Old buildings have supplies, but they're often guarded.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：曾经的建筑物有物资，但它们通常有人看着。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Everywhere I look, death. Suffering. And... hope.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：放眼望去，死亡。苦难。还有……希望。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. I've seen children, families. Life goes on.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：我见过孩子，也见过一个个家庭。日子还在继续。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Marriage is not uncommon. You can't kill love.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：结婚并不少见。爱情是杀不死的。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Radscorpion. Stinger plus claws equals death.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：辐射蝎。尾刺加螯钳，等于死亡。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Lock picking is an essential skill for gaining access.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：开锁是进入各处的必备技能。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Many functional computer terminals. Hacking a necessity.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：不少计算机终端还能正常运转。黑客技术必不可少。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Medical training is essential for survival.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：医学训练是生存的关键。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. The Brotherhood of Steel favors technology. Worships it.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：钢铁兄弟会崇尚科技，甚至把它当神明崇拜。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Training with a variety of guns is a must.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：各式枪支都得练熟。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Music, painting, dance. Art and culture survive.
ZH: 探险家日志。新条目：音乐、绘画、舞蹈。艺术与文化仍延续至今。

EN: a Savage Dog, snarling angrily.
ZH: 一只凶残的野狗，正愤怒地低吼。

EN: a hideous little Mole rat.
ZH: 一只丑陋的小鼹鼠。

EN: a Bloatfly, buzzing dangerously close.
ZH: 一只巨大苍蝇，危险地嗡嗡叫着靠近。

EN: a disgusting Radroach.
ZH: 一只令人讨厌的辐射蟑螂。

EN: a terrifying Yao Guai!
ZH: 一只可怕的妖怪熊！

EN: a wandering Feral Ghoul.
ZH: 一只四处游荡的狂尸鬼。

EN: a Giant Ant.
ZH: 一只巨型蚂蚁。

EN: a Scavenger's Dog, sniffing for salvage.
ZH: 一只拾荒者的狗，嗅着废品的味道。

EN: a Giant Worker Ant.
ZH: 一只巨型工蚁。

EN: a Radscorpion.
ZH: 一只辐射蝎。

EN: a Giant Soldier Ant.
ZH: 一只巨型兵蚁。

EN: a Fire Ant Soldier.
ZH: 一只火兵蚁。

EN: a Guard Dog, watching the area.
ZH: 一只看门狗，正警戒着四周。

EN: a Fire Ant Warrior.
ZH: 一只火蚁战士。

EN: a barnacle-encrusted Mirelurk.
ZH: 一只结满藤壶的泥沼蟹。

EN: a psychotic Feral Ghoul Roamer.
ZH: 一只癫狂的狂尸鬼漫游者。

EN: a Giant Radscorpion.
ZH: 一只巨型辐射蝎。

EN: a Mirelurk Hunter.
ZH: 一只泥沼蟹猎杀者。

EN: a Vicious Dog, ripping apart a corpse.
ZH: 一只恶犬，正在撕咬一具尸体。

EN: a repulsive Centaur.
ZH: 一只令人厌恶的多脚兽。

EN: a dangerous Feral Ghoul Reaver.
ZH: 一个危险的狂尸鬼掠夺者。

EN: a deadly Deathclaw.
ZH: 一只致命的死爪。

EN: an Enclave Deathclaw.
ZH: 一只英克雷死爪。

EN: a Super Mutant.
ZH: 一个超级变种人。

EN: a Super Mutant Master.
ZH: 一个超级变种人大师。

EN: a Super Mutant Overlord.
ZH: 一个超级变种人霸王。

EN: a gigantic Super Mutant Behemoth.
ZH: 一只硕大的超级变种人巨兽。

EN: an old, abandoned Broadcasting Tower.
ZH: 一座古旧废弃的广播塔。

EN: a group of Raiders, looking for someone to terrorize.
ZH: 一群掠夺者，正找人恐吓。

EN: an Abandoned Shack.
ZH: 一个废弃的小屋。

EN: an old Refrigerator. Could be something inside.
ZH: 一个旧冰箱。里面可能有东西。

EN: a locked Safe.
ZH: 一个锁住的保险箱。

EN: a Super Duper Mart.
ZH: 一个大无敌超市。

EN: a small group of escaped Slaves.
ZH: 一小群逃跑的奴隶。

EN: a well-guarded Slave Camp.
ZH: 一个守卫严密的奴隶营。

EN: a deserted Gas Station.
ZH: 一个废弃的加油站。

EN: what appears to be an Abandoned Diner.
ZH: 一处貌似废弃的小餐馆。

EN: what seems to be an old National Guard Depot.
ZH: 一个看起来像是旧国民警卫队仓库的地方。

EN: Goodneighbor.
ZH: 芳邻镇。

EN: the C.I.T. Ruins.
ZH: C.I.T.废墟。

EN: the Museum of Witchcraft.
ZH: 巫术博物馆。

EN: the Weston Water Treatment Plant.
ZH: 韦斯顿水处理厂。

EN: the Hubris Comics headquarters.
ZH: “虎不理漫画”公司总部。

EN: Gwinnett Brewery.
ZH: 谷内啤酒厂。

EN: a Fugitive Slave.
ZH: 一名逃亡的奴隶。

EN: a Wounded Sheriff.
ZH: 一名受伤的警长。

EN: a traveling Ghoul.
ZH: 一个游走的尸鬼。

EN: a wandering Merchant.
ZH: 一名流浪的商人。

EN: a group of Talon Company Mercs.
ZH: 一伙鹰爪公司雇佣兵。

EN: a Hunter.
ZH: 一名猎人。

EN: a Drunken Drifter.
ZH: 一个喝醉酒的流浪汉。

EN: a Brotherhood Patrol.
ZH: 一支兄弟会巡逻队。

EN: a Lost Farmer. He's tired and scared.
ZH: 一位迷路的农民。他又累又怕。

EN: a malfunctioning Mister Handy.
ZH: 一个出故障的巧手先生。

EN: a boarded up Convenience Store.
ZH: 一家用木板封死的便利店。

EN: an empty, nearly collapsed Raider Hideout.
ZH: 一处空荡荡、几近坍塌的掠夺者藏身处。

EN: an Irradiated Lake.
ZH: 一个被辐射污染的湖。

EN: a Sealed Room in a house basement.
ZH: 地下室的一个封闭房间。

EN: a large Apartment Building.
ZH: 一幢大型公寓楼。

EN: a well-defended Outpost of Survivors.
ZH: 一处防御严密的幸存者前哨站。

EN: a bustling Children of Atom Camp blocking the road.
ZH: 一处熙熙攘攘的原子之子营地，挡住了去路。

EN: an Old Mansion, long since sacked.
ZH: 一座老公馆，早就被洗劫一空。

EN: a Robot Factory, with broken Protectrons scattered outside.
ZH: 一个机器人工厂，损坏的保护者机器人散落在外。

EN: a Dark Cave in the middle of the woods.
ZH: 树林中间的一个黑暗的山洞。

EN: a Caravan Merchant chasing after a panicked Brahmin.
ZH: 一名大篷车商人正在追逐一头受惊的双头牛。

EN: a Wide Open Field, impossible to cross without being spotted.
ZH: 一片开阔的田野，想不被发现地穿过去根本不可能。

EN: Here we go.
ZH: 说走就走。

EN: Finally, some fresh air.
ZH: 总算能呼吸上新鲜空气了。

EN: I won't stray too far. Just in case.
ZH: 我不会走得太远，以防万一。

EN: This doesn't seem so bad.
ZH: 似乎不那么糟糕。

EN: Once more unto the breach!
ZH: 再一次冲锋陷阵！

EN: It's brighter than I expected.
ZH: 比我想象的要亮。

EN: Wow, is it always this hot out here?
ZH: 哇，外面一直都这么热吗？

EN: Away we go!
ZH: 出发喽！

EN: I wonder what's left?
ZH: 不知道外面还剩下些什么呢？

EN: All right, Wasteland. Here I come!
ZH: 来吧，废土！我来了！

EN: Ah. So that's why they call it the Wasteland.
ZH: 呃。难怪人家管这儿叫“废土”。

EN: Yep. Everything's destroyed.
ZH: 是的。一切都毁了。

EN: Okay, this is kind of... depressing.
ZH: 好吧，这有点儿……让人沮丧。

EN: I'll make the Vault proud. They'll see.
ZH: 我会让避难所为我骄傲的。等着瞧。

EN: And I'm off!
ZH: 这就出发！

EN: Thought I'd never get out of there.
ZH: 还以为这辈子都出不去了呢。

EN: This is so exciting!
ZH: 太让人兴奋了！

EN: I'm ready for anything.
ZH: 我已经准备好了一切。

EN: Come on Wasteland show me what you've got!
ZH: 来吧，废土！让我看看你到底有什么本事！

EN: Okay. I can do this.
ZH: 好。我能行的。

EN: I wonder how far I can get on foot?
ZH: 不知道光靠两条腿能走多远？

EN: Super Mutants are just a myth... right?
ZH: 超级变种人只是个传说……对吧？

EN: This isn't so bad. Maybe we should all leave the Vault...
ZH: 这还不算太坏。也许我们都应该离开避难所……

EN: Hope I can find my way back.
ZH: 希望我能找到回家的路。

EN: I'll grab just as much as I can carry, then head back.
ZH: 能拿多少拿多少，然后就回去。

EN: If I find just one box of Sugar Bombs, it'll be worth it.
ZH: 如果只发现了一盒糖衣炸弹麦片，那也是值得的。

EN: I guess I'll head... that way.
ZH: 我想我就往……那边走吧。

EN: Maybe I should have dropped some bread crumbs.
ZH: 早知道就一路撒点面包屑了。

EN: This way looks promising.
ZH: 这条路看上去还不错。

EN: My feet hurt already.
ZH: 我的脚已经开始疼了。

EN: Starting to regret coming out here.
ZH: 开始后悔来这里。

EN: Maybe I'm not cut out for exploring after all.
ZH: 也许我压根就不是探险的料。

EN: I will not return a failure. I will not return a failure...
ZH: 我不会失败而归的。我不会失败而归的……

EN: The Vault's counting on me. I've got to push on.
ZH: 整个避难所都指望我呢。我得继续前进。

EN: That way looks promising.
ZH: 那条路看上去还不错。

EN: I'm bound to run into somebody sooner or later.
ZH: 我迟早会遇到什么人。

EN: I really don't want to get eaten out here...
ZH: 我真的不想在这里被吃掉……

EN: If I die out here, they'll never know...
ZH: 如果我死在这里，他们永远不会知道……

EN: This way looks as good as any.
ZH: 这条路看着不比别的差。

EN: There's got to be something out here.
ZH: 这外面总该有点什么吧。

EN: Trying to pull off the boards blocking the front door.
ZH: 正试图撬开挡在前门的木板。

EN: Exploring the Hideout, but one wrong step will make it fall on my head.
ZH: 探索藏身处，但只要走错一步，上头就会整个塌下来砸到我头上。

EN: Something's floating near the shore. I'll try to get it.
ZH: 岸边漂着个东西。我看看能不能把它捞上来。

EN: Hacking a terminal to get the door open.
ZH: 正在破解终端，好把门打开。

EN: Looking around for supplies, but this place is full of booby traps.
ZH: 四处寻找物资，但这地方布满了陷阱。

EN: Trying to convince them to let me in so I can rest.
ZH: 试图说服他们让我进去休息。

EN: Going around will take too much time. I'll have to try sneaking through the Camp.
ZH: 绕过去会花太多时间。我要试着偷偷穿过营地。

EN: Searching the Mansion for anything of value that might have been left behind.
ZH: 找找公馆里还有没有任何有价值的东西。

EN: The door is sealed. If I can fix a Protectron's laser arm, I could blast it open.
ZH: 门封得死死的。要是能修好保护者机器人的激光手臂，就能把门轰开。

EN: I've been cornered in the Cave by a family of Yao Guai. I'll try to pacify them.
ZH: 被妖怪熊一家人逼到了山洞的角落。我会尽力安抚它们。
